title: Applied ML research blitz notes — quant & evals
content:
Overview:
This doc captures a focused 3-day research blitz (2027-08-11 -> 2027-08-13). Primary goals: 1) exercise compact quant profiles (8-bit PTQ and 4-bit GPTQ variants) across 7B/13B families, 2) extend eval harness to measure hallucination/regression signals, 3) iterate on model onboarding checklist for Dedicated/Private deployments.

Attendees / facilitators:
- Aisha Raman (scribe)
- Marcus Chen (experiments lead)
- Elena Ortiz (eval harness)
- Priya Malhotra (onboarding & compliance)
- Jon Park (infra / runtime)

Kickoff notes (Wed 08/11):
- Timeboxed to 2 full days of experiments + 1 day for synthesis.
- Scope narrowed: run PTQ-8 and GPTQ-4 on 13B-base & 7B-variant; measure token throughput, latency (p50/p95), memory, LM perplexity, QA F1 on our narrow QA probe set, and hallucination rate introduced by new probe set.
- Runtime targets: prefer batch=1 latency profiles for API-SLA signals; simulate long-context behavior up to 32k with synthetic KV padding where possible.

Experiment inventory (links to notebooks/PRs in linked_artifacts):
- qb-13b-ptq8-static-0811: 13B, PTQ-8 static quant, tested on p4d-sim nodes. 
  - Findings: ~1.8x throughput vs fp16; median latency 84ms @ batch=1; memory -34%; LM perplexity +2.1% on lm-eval-subset; hallucination delta negligible on short prompts.
- qb-13b-gptq4-perc-0812: 13B, GPTQ-4 per-channel approximation, tested on ampere-sim.
  - Findings: ~3.6x throughput vs fp16; median latency 108ms; perplexity +8.3%; QA F1 drop 3.5 pts on narrow QA probe; observed token repetition on >8k sequences.
- qb-7b-gptq4-compact-0812: 7B, GPTQ-4 tuned variant.
  - Findings: Best perf/quality balance; p50 56ms, QA regression <1pt; candidate for staging routing.
- microbatch-continuous: evaluate continuous batching cost model at batch sizes 2/4/8 for 7B/13B quant profiles.
  - Findings: throughput up, p95 increases; recommend dynamic batching with latency SLO threshold.

Repro issues / anomalies observed:
- Kernel OOM on ampere nodes when generating beyond ~12k tokens with GPTQ-4 13B. Repro steps in runtime PR; likely related to driver allocation patterns + a bug in fallback allocator path.
- Tokenizer mismatch: one eval run used tokenizer.json from model repo v1.2 while the eval harness pulled v1.1. Caused truncated generation in several prompts. Fix: add tokenizer checksum validation to harness and model onboarding checklist.
- Occasional degenerate repetition on long-context seeds for GPTQ-4 variants. Hypothesis: quant noise accumulates in KV scales; need per-KV-scale preservation experiment.

Decisions made:
- Promote 7B-GPTQ-4 to staging inference pool for internal load testing and QA. Action: Marcus to file infra ticket and coordinate CD pipeline (due 2027-08-16).
- Do NOT promote 13B-GPTQ-4 to Dedicated/private until hallucination/regression root cause investigated and mitigations validated (err on side of safety).
- Add hallucination probes (120 prompts) to nightly regression suite. Action: Elena to add prompts + tagging logic (due 2027-08-20).
- Kernel fallback policy: prefer PTQ-8 on Ampere for sequences >8k as interim measure. Add policy flag to model spec schema.

Action items (owner / due):
- Marcus Chen: reproduce OOM locally with memory trace and coredump; open AI-4023 with artifact bundle (due 2027-08-16).
- Elena Ortiz: integrate hallucination tagging into nightly evals, update Confluence with methodology (due 2027-08-20).
- Priya Malhotra: extend model onboarding checklist to include tokenizer checksum, kernel-policy flag, and a perf-smoke test for long contexts (due 2027-08-18).
- Jon Park: add temporary node-level guard that caps effective seq padding on ampere pool and alerts when fallback occurs (due 2027-08-17).
- Aisha Raman: consolidate this doc into one-pager for product + ops (due 2027-08-14).

Quick wins and patches to land next sprint:
- Tokenizer.json checksum validation hook in eval harness and pre-commit (1 day)
- Add per-token p95 telemetry tagging by quant-profile in runtime metrics (2-3 days)
- Enforce model-spec kernel-policy flag parsing in deployment orchestration (2 days)

Longer-term experiment ideas (backlog):
- QAT pilot on 13B to see if narrow QA regressions and hallucination drift reduce compared to GPTQ while maintaining ~2-3x perf. Worth a 2-week dedicated pilot.
- KV-cache-aware quantization: evaluate preserving KV scales separately or per-head to reduce long-context drift.
- Investigate calibration/temperature-aware post-quantization scaling to reduce token repetition.

Risk summary (brief):
- Customer risk: rolling 13B-GPTQ-4 to Dedicated could expose hallucination/regression in high-value contracts. Mitigation: keep as canary only internally until regression <1pt on QA.
- Infra risk: Ampere OOM can cause noisy falling back to CPU slow paths; mitigation: kernel policy + node caps + alerting.

Retrospective notes (how the blitz went):
- Positive: clarity of goals, rapid iteration, clear owner assignments.
- Improvements: prepare controlled long-context seed corpus earlier; pre-validate tokenizer versions across model artifacts and harness; include perf telemetry hook before first run.

Next sync:

Informal notes / scratch (keep brief):
- Naming suggestion: use pattern qb-<model>-<quant>-<date> for experiment ids.
- Possible short-term label: "safe-for-dedicated: yes/no" on model registry metadata.
